role: Post-result diagnostic review of the already fixed stock mechanism; not a preregistered original strategy, new candidate or OOS evidence.

primary_crypto_source.alignment: Use the last completed hourly bucket ending exactly at the frozen US exchange session close; never the bucket opening at that close. Include weekend and holiday price movement from the preceding stock close. No UTC calendar-day close substitution.
primary_crypto_source.coverage: Every hour from 2022-12-30 00:00 UTC through 2024-06-27 00:00 UTC. No missing/duplicate/conflicting required anchor and no imputed return.
primary_crypto_source.limits: USD exchange spot price control, not broker executable price, transfer or account settlement proof. Actual final trade clock within bucket is not given.

source_crosscheck.purpose: Seven fixed clock and cross-market spot-proxy comparisons using the available read-only plugin. USDT quote is not assumed equal to USD; differences remain visible. This is not independent strategy verification.

regressions.method: OLS with intercept; HAC Bartlett lag5, finite-sample correction, Student-t95 intervals, same settings as prior audit. No lag, factor subset, date or window search.
outcomes: paired focal minus fixed equity control net daily return
regressions.baseline: Existing same-period two-factor regression, retained unchanged. Extended three-factor regressions are a descriptive sensitivity, not causal alpha or discovery-adjusted significance.
report: COIN inventory and marked-PnL contribution alongside exposures
